finding.claim: The observed config change record for change_id runtime-1 (evidence incident_1002-E-004, service backend, observed_at 2026-10-01T12:00:10Z) shows db_pool_max reduced from 20 to 2 with concurrency=120, indicating a backend connection/thread pool limit regression relative to the prior configuration.
finding.followup_question: Confirm the complete runtime-1 diff parameter set (including any pool timeout parameter) and its exact timestamp relative to error onset.

predicted_observations: Connection-pool acquisition waits/timeouts on backend appearing at or after the db_pool_max 20->2 reduction
Errors concentrated in the period after the observed config change observed_at 2026-10-01T12:00:10Z
Backend CPU/memory saturation with pool sizing left unchanged
Saturation onset not aligned to any pool limit or pool timeout change
open_questions: Determine whether backend CPU/memory saturation is present independently of the pool sizing reduction, which would compete with the pool-config-regression explanation.

requested_checks.question: In the window spanning the runtime-1 change (observed_at 2026-10-01T12:00:10Z), do backend connection-pool utilization, pool wait time, and latency/error metrics show saturation or timeouts correlated with the db_pool_max 20->2 reduction?
requested_checks.reason: Discriminates backend_pool_config_regression (pool wait/timeout saturation aligned to the config reduction) from backend_resource_saturation (CPU/memory saturation independent of pool sizing), given the diff evidence is metadata-limited.
requested_checks.expected_discriminator: Pool wait/timeout metrics rising only after the pool limit reduction supports backend_pool_config_regression; saturation with pool metrics unchanged or with unchanged limits supports backend_resource_saturation.

requested_checks.question: Do backend logs at or after the runtime-1 change timestamp contain connection pool exhaustion or acquisition timeout errors consistent with the reduced db_pool_max?
requested_checks.reason: Confirms whether the reduced db_pool_max produced observable connection acquisition failures, strengthening or refuting the config-regression mechanism.
requested_checks.expected_discriminator: Pool-acquisition timeout errors appearing at/after the change support backend_pool_config_regression; their absence with no pool pressure refutes it.
